last_batch.research: PubMed E-utilities searches covered 30 final fresh non-prescription low-back-pain and musculoskeletal self-management topics. The main query set returned 176 unique PubMed PMIDs, 174 fetched article records, and 174 abstracts available for inspection. Retained numeric effects or valid relative effects were verified for PMIDs: 38908392, 38035307, 33369625, 31630089, 40152243, 26329399, 30867144, 38820011, 36045306, 34924557, 29565945, 32520991, 39973246, 10936472, and 31666220. Sixteen retained references were added across 16 new entries. New entries cover walking, aerobic exercise, resistance exercise, core stabilization exercise, motor skill training, cognitive functional therapy, acupressure, massage, spinal manipulation, red-light therapy, kinesio taping, weight loss, vitamin D, L-serine·EPA, turmeric·Boswellia, and willow bark; mindfulness, devil's claw, capsaicin, ginger, yoga, and Pilates topics were linked to existing entries. McKenzie exercise, myofascial release, heat therapy, TENS, ergonomic education, posture training, and sleep education topics were screened out because the retrieved PubMed records did not provide a retained topic-specific numeric intervention-versus-control result or valid relative effect.
